# Subtitles & Text Effects

Generate subtitles and decorative text effects for an ecommerce short video from a timing JSON of cues: one ASS file holding four styles at once (bottom subtitles, big pop-in hook titles, a top-left sticker tag and a call-to-action button), keyword highlighting, sequential splitting of long cues, a plain SRT of the bottom subtitles, platform UI safe zones that keep text clear of the bottom and right-hand buttons, and ffmpeg/libass burn-in.
